Sophisticated Escape in the Heart of the City
Mar 2026 • Friends
If you’re looking for a sophisticated escape in the heart of the city, Boudoir Lounge at the Sofitel is an absolute standout.
The ambiance strikes that perfect balance between luxury and comfort. Its the kind of place that feels both intimate and grand, making it ideal whether you’re decompressing after a day of travel or looking for a polished spot for a meeting.
The highlight of the experience, however, was the service. Our server, Xuan, was exceptional. She was attentive, professional, and had a genuine warmth that really elevated the entire afternoon. It’s rare to find service that is this seamless and intuitive.
If you’re at the Sofitel (or even if you’re just in the neighborhood), do yourself a favor and stop by. Ask for Xuan, she’ll take great care of you.
